goals: Invite a class using a validated CSV preview and explicit send action
Keep individual student acceptance and existing connection privacy intact
Provide per-row outcomes and safe retries for mixed or partially failed imports

issues.title: [Connections] Validated CSV roster invitation API and safe retries
issues.implementationDetails: Faculty-only multipart preview/send endpoints accept UTF-8 CSV with required email and optional name, up to 256 KB/500 rows. Parsing handles BOM, CRLF, quoted fields, invalid columns and case-normalized duplicate emails. Preview performs no writes and returns only uploaded labels, not database profiles/IDs. Confirmed send rechecks current accounts and relationships, uses unique-pair upserts in bounded batches, never changes accepted/incoming requests, and reports each partial failure for safe retry. Count-only import auditing excludes file content, names and emails.

issues.title: [Connections] Class roster preview template and row reports
issues.implementationDetails: Faculty Connections includes a collapsible class-invitation panel, downloadable CSV template, file limits, validation preview with counts/status/reasons, explicit sending and per-row result downloads. Selecting a different file clears prior preview. Existing requests are skipped when previewing again; incoming requests still require manual review. Spreadsheet formulas are neutralized in downloaded uploaded fields. Desktop/mobile layouts preserve readable controls and a keyboard-focusable scrolling table. Individual acceptance remains mandatory; an invited but unaccepted classmate is denied private content.

validation.finalResponsiveCheck: The roster browser workflow and both production builds passed again after mobile disclosure and table-scroll hint polish.
validation.visualReview: Roster preview screenshots inspected at 1440px desktop and 390px mobile. Horizontal overflow stays inside the table. Downloaded template and spreadsheet-safe row report checked in the browser workflow.

integration.description: Built on Sprint 8 in PR #35. After PR #32 and PR #35 merged, the completed CSV changes were merged into develop.

limits: Imports invite existing active student accounts inside Quikz; they do not send email, verify mailboxes or create accounts.
Files must be UTF-8 CSV with email and optional name columns, up to 256 KB and 500 student records.
Imported names are file labels and do not update profiles. CSV row numbers count records rather than physical lines inside quoted fields.
Partial failures keep successful invitations; previewing again safely skips existing connections and requests.
Verification uses Chromium and isolated local MongoDB, not a live Atlas deployment.
